text.card: TOI 7265A is a star of 4,457 K, bound to TOI-7265 B 2,617 AU away.
text.introduction: TOI 7265A shares its motion through space with TOI-7265 B, 2,617 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: TOI 7265A's orbit around TOI-7265 B is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
